summary: Transaction.java correctly implements EIP-1559 transaction-level requirements: EIP-1559 signing preimage (0x02 || rlp chain_id, nonce, max_priority, max_fee, gas_limit, destination, amount, data, access_list), effective priority fee as min(max_priority, max_fee-base_fee), effective gas price as priority+base, and max upfront cost as gas_limit*max_fee+value. No deviation in fee handling, type handling, or signature recovery was found; block-level base-fee calculation, gas-limit validation and burn are delegated to other Besu components outside this file's scope.
